issues.note: Weekday issue on release and productive forgetting: Ada's historical explainer on Lisp garbage collection (McCarthy mark-and-sweep, Cheney copying, Dijkstra's concurrent collector); Norbert's argument for an unassisted first page, grounded in Doshi and Hauser's creativity experiment; Karel's straight short fiction about a household privacy gap and an intentionally deleted piano recording. Deliberately avoids today's model releases and FAA story, plus the recent quantization, benchmark, agent-review, and harness themes.
